summary: Before honors you need at least 9 units in three education (EDUC) courses, letter graded, with a 3.0 GPA in them and the honors director's approval; the audit checks the courses and you check the GPA and approval by hand. You take the three senior honors seminar courses (EDUC 199A, 199B and 199C) and enroll in EDUC 140 with your advisor in both winter and spring, for at least 7 units in all. The honors thesis and its spring presentation are checked by the department.
